text:
alex_support: Heads-up: customer 'Greenline' reporting manager-level rows missing from org usage charts for the last 30 days after we applied a retention update. Individual user timelines exist but manager/role aggregates show 'No data'.
jeff_support_mgr: Escalating to eng. Any console errors or API traces? :eyes:
alex_support: Console shows 204 from metrics endpoint and the UI just renders empty state at /org/greenline/usage. Customer pasted this error text.

alex_support: ```
curl -X POST https://console/api/metrics/query -d '{"org_id":"org-greenline","start":"2026-02-01","end":"2026-03-16","role":"manager"}'
# returns 204 No Content
```
emma_engineer: I can repro against a prod-copy. Quick triage: org_policy.ttl_seconds for linked orgs got set to 0 by last night's retention-override script. Our role-scoped aggregates are dropped when ttl==0 because the prune job removes role_index keys. Digging into why the script wrote 0 for linked orgs.
lucas_infra: That was the script that applied inheritance=false defaults. I can roll back for org-greenline if we want to test recovery.
alex_support: Customer is on Dedicated and prefers a temporary fix rather than a full rollback. Can we avoid pruning manager aggregates or re-run the aggregate job for them?
emma_engineer: Two options: 1) hotfix to treat ttl==0 as "do not prune" for role-scoped historical aggregates, 2) re-run a targeted backfill/reindex for roles for the org. I'll prepare a PR for (1) and an ad-hoc reindex job for (2).
sara_prod: Note that backfill cost is non-trivial. Greenline estimated ~40k metric tokens/day => ~6 hours on m-series workers. Need approval from finance/product for any large run.
maria_security: Please confirm reprocessing won't surface PII or external logs. Also need audit log entry for who/what set ttl_seconds to 0.
metrics-bot: Created ticket SVC-7896 (reindex-greenline) and linked SVC-7894 (retention-overwrite).
emma_engineer: Repro steps I'm documenting: 1) hit metrics/query with role filter -> observe 204; 2) check `select ttl_seconds from org_policy where org_id='org-greenline'` -> returns 0; 3) run: ```python scripts/reindex_org.py --org org-greenline --scope roles --from 2026-01-01 --to 2026-03-16``` to rebuild role aggregates.
jeff_support_mgr: Can you also add a guard so future runs of the retention override script skip linked orgs or don't write 0? Customer timeline: they can accept maintenance tonight. Emma, can you scope the hotfix + reindex ETA?
emma_engineer: Will open PR hotfix/retention-guard now, target merge in next 2 hours if no blocker. Backfill job queued after merge; estimate start-to-finish ~ 5-7 hours. I'll add a flag to limit to roles only to reduce cost.
alex_support: I'll notify Greenline (SVC-7896) with rollback plan & ETA and recommend temporary workaround: use per-user charts (no role filter). Will follow up when PR merged. :thumbsup:
